text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Seiun Sky—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
This might seem a bit out of the blue, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Do you happen to enjoy fishing?
choice_data_list: What's this about all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, we're just making small talk.
Come on, just picture it for a second."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Let's say there's a pond in front of you.
And let's say you're focusing on the rod in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...How about it? Do you feel like you'll catch something?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, great answer! Let's get right into the real thing, then.
I'll be expecting a big haul.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looked over at the claw machine.
Inside were plushies modeled after Umamusume. Could this be...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "It's totally fine, a master angler like you, Trainer, will find it a breeze. ...Right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I do feel like I was talked into it a bit,
but as her Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
